source.title: Subliminal Prompting Beyond Static Geometry: Causal Depth and Multi-Token Confounds

record.tranche_reason: Tests the frozen prompting analogue and candidate signal measures with behavioral scoring, readouts, and activation patching rather than testing the original teacher-to-student fine-tuning procedure.
record.gate_note: The study tests frozen animal-number prompting and its candidate signal measures. It does not fine-tune students or test teacher-student base-model compatibility. Values cited from prior work are not recorded as results. The external prediction check uses released student-transfer outcomes; it is recorded separately as a finding about prediction rather than as a direct test of transfer.
record.test_reason: Frozen-model study of the Zur et al. animal-number prompting channel. It measures the bidirectional behavioural association (version F) and whether static output-vector geometry, i.e. token entanglement, tracks it (version D) in Llama-3.1-8B/70B and Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B. It does no teacher data generation or student fine-tuning, so A, B, C and E are untested. Its patching and readout results concern the timing of answer-position control, not which candidate carrier transmits the signal.
record.authors_conclusion: The record's paraphrase is largely correct. Add that the behavioural association persists at 70B with an unresolved scale change, and the fixed-head readout change is also unresolved. The authors say the results constrain token-level explanations of the frozen prompting channel but do not identify the mechanism of training-time transfer.
record.recipe_differences: Uses frozen animal-number prompts, output-vector and hidden-state measurements, and natural-state activation patching; it does not generate filtered teacher data or fine-tune a student.
record.method_sensitivity: Model scale changes the geometry and causal-depth results; Qwen scoring results depend on sequence scoring, per-token averaging, and control for number width. Causal effects were checked against donor concept shifts, pair-cluster omission, direction halves, and raw-logit scoring.

fits_no_version.finding: Natural-state donor patching at the final assistant position. Donor-control AUC rises from 0.254 (8B) to 0.540 (70B), paired +0.286 [+0.272,+0.300], 18/18 concepts. With eight blocks remaining, the donor coefficient is 0.592 vs 0.948. Wrong-concept, raw-logit and identity controls hold.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: In frozen Llama-3.1 prompting, answer-position state gains causal control of the animal answer earlier in relative depth at 70B than at 8B.

fits_no_version.finding: Fixed output-head readout AUC is 0.259 vs 0.269, with an unresolved paired change (+0.010, CI includes zero). Readability does not track the causal scale shift.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Observational readability of the prompted animal is dissociated from causal donor control across scale.

fits_no_version.finding: Outcome-blinded check against released single-seed student-transfer outcomes for 16 animals. Static geometry ρ=0.562 (q=0.078), causal donor AUC ρ=0.111 (q=0.687), released steering benchmark ρ=0.768. None of the in-house measures passed the corrected gate.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Frozen prompting-channel measures do not reliably predict fine-tuning transfer strength across animals.

record.problems: The study measures frozen prompting, not student fine-tuning, and explicitly says it cannot establish the mechanism of training-time transfer. The causal protocol was prospectively designed with a validation-stage estimator repair rather than being an unchanged preregistration. The matched scale comparison is one same-release Llama pair; causal depth is sampled at five points; the Qwen comparison uses two small models and cannot isolate tokenizer effects from architecture, training, or scale. Intervals cover the fixed concept and pair design, not arbitrary models or concepts.
record.rows_left_out: The saved-array sensitivity restricting geometry/readout to the 256 causal numbers is not separately recorded. The 8B backend repeat, number-position readout, exact identity error, design condition numbers, leave-one-pair-out range, and direction-half checks are described in text but not separately rowed because they are sensitivity or implementation controls rather than distinct primary outcome measures. The external prediction check is noted under fits_no_version but lacks a row because no row ID was assigned to that prediction analysis.

untested.parts: Entire version: no teacher-generated filtered data and no student fine-tuning.
Entire version: no same-base vs different-base student training.
Entire version: no misalignment or harmful traits.
Carrier of training-time transfer. Divergence tokens, steering-vector direction and gradient argument are not tested; only static output-vector geometry for the frozen prompting channel is.
Entire version: no full fine-tuning, LoRA rank or evaluation-prompt variation.

Trait shift in free generation or open-ended preference rates. Only first-token animal logits under number-love system prompts and their correlation with forward scores are measured, with no no-number baseline.

missing.what: Paired 70B−8B change in bidirectional behavioural correlation: −0.0241 [−0.0563,+0.0087], 6/18 animals increase, medians 0.117 and 0.088
External prediction check correlations (ρ and BH q for geometry, causal AUC and steering benchmark vs released transfer outcomes)

record.verdict_notes: The reader's D 'supports' label from patching was dropped: full-state final-position patching does not test any candidate carrier named in D, and the authors disclaim mechanism identification. The reader's D 'challenges' label for geometry vs causal was replaced with limits_scope, because geometry remains positive and only weakens. Qwen rows are linked to F as well as D, since they use the same bidirectional behavioural measure. The Qwen contrast confounds tokenizer with family, training and scale, per the authors. Single-author preprint; the causal estimator was repaired at the validation stage before main collection.

versions.untested_parts: Teacher-generated filtered data, student fine-tuning, and acquisition of a trait after training.
No student training comparison between same-base and different-base teacher-student pairs.
No misalignment or other harmful trait is tested.

Tests frozen prompting-channel geometry, readout, and causal donor-state control, not training-time transfer. Does not identify divergence tokens, a steering-vector-like direction, or a gradient mechanism.
No full fine-tuning, LoRA-rank, or evaluation-prompt robustness comparison.
Tests animal-number prompting, but not literal insertion of identified linked tokens into a prompt as a separate intervention.
